name: Astera Labs
thesis: Connectivity silicon (retimers, Scorpio switches) inside AI racks; Q2 revenue $392M, +104% YoY. Closed $357.84 Tuesday (+1.9%), down 2% since Sep 28 after a 42% run from Sep 14. Fubon initiated at Buy with a $500 target on Sep 29; Scorpio X becoming the largest product line in Q3 is the proof point.
risks: ~175x earnings and within 9% of the $390 consensus target, so the easy rebound is done. Few hyperscaler customers, and Nvidia NVLink competes directly.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Top custom AI chip (XPU) and AI networking supplier; Q3 FY26 AI revenue $16.7B, +221% YoY, Q4 guide ~$34.8B total revenue. Closed $355.10 Tuesday (+1.6%) with the chip rebound, still roughly flat since Sep 14 while peers ran; consensus target $532 (+50%).
risks: Off-balance-sheet guarantees on Anthropic chip financing ($35B done, ~$60B more discussed). China's SASAC is surveying Broadcom switches in state data centres ahead of possible guidance to cut use.
catalyst: Q4 FY2026 earnings ~2026-12-10 (est.); any SASAC guidance on switches

name: SK hynix
thesis: Holds ~58% of HBM revenue share; Q2 operating income KRW 60.5T at a 76% margin, and the stock trades near 9x earnings. The ADR fell as much as 6% Monday after Bloomberg reported Solidigm is weighing a US IPO as soon as 2027 at up to $100B, then bounced 2.6% Tuesday to $186.68, -2.5% since Sep 28. The strike risk is gone (union deal approved Sep 16). Seoul +1.4% at 11:11 KST (prev close 1,765,000). ADR closed $186.68 (+2.6%) Tuesday, $185.82 in the overnight session. Bernstein cut its target to 2.7m won from 3.3m (Outperform kept) on slower HBM4 pricing and prefers Samsung; Micron reports Thu 06:30 AEST.
risks: A separate Solidigm listing adds an ownership layer investors already discount; the Korea Corporate Governance Forum urged SK hynix to drop it. Memory is the most volatile part of any AI selloff, and CXMT is closing the gap.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-27 (est.); Micron results Wed Sep 30 set the tone; Solidigm IPO bank selection

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: On-site fuel cells for AI data centres; Q2 revenue $1.07B, +166%, 2026 guide $3.9-4.2B. Jumped 10.8% Tuesday to $291.25 (+10% since Sep 28, +241% YTD) after leasing another 158,000 sq ft in Fremont, nearly doubling production space; RBC reiterated Outperform at $335 and Morgan Stanley $310.
risks: Now above the $286 consensus target at ~380x earnings, and Monday's 8.6% drop shows how fast it reverses. Oracle's Jupiter force majeure stands: gas pipeline slipped to Feb 2027, fuel-cell air permit due Nov 23. Several class actions pending.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings 2026-10-27; Jupiter air-quality permit decision by 2026-11-23

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Bottleneck supplier of gas turbines and grid gear for AI power; Q2 orders $24.2B (+88% organic), backlog ~$176B. Closed $962.49 Tuesday (+1.3%, +10% since Sep 14) as the NRC issued TVA the first US construction permit for its BWRX-300 small modular reactor at Clinch River, the second US reactor permit in nearly a decade. Consensus target $1,237 (+29%).
risks: Premium multiple on a cyclical business (GLJ Sell, $470 target). Tariffs cost $100-200M in 2026, offshore wind still loses money, and TVA has no construction date or cost-sharing deal yet for the SMR.

name: Vertiv Holdings
thesis: Power, thermal and liquid-cooling infrastructure for AI data centres; Q2 net sales $3.27B (+24%, 18% organic) at a 22.6% adjusted operating margin (+410bps), with 2026 guidance of $14.0B and 31% organic growth. Closed $248.34 Tuesday (+1.8%). Wells Fargo initiated Overweight at $340 on Sep 26 as the best sales-growth story in multi-industry, BofA added it to its US 1 list, and it agreed to buy King Environmental Services for European liquid-cooling services on Sep 24. Consensus $338 (+36%).
risks: 56x earnings prices in the guide; Q2 organic growth was 18% with acquisitions and FX doing the rest, so the second half has to accelerate. Hyperscaler capex concentration, and Schneider, Eaton and Asian OEMs compete in liquid cooling. Replaces Toyota; added at medium conviction until Q3 confirms the ramp.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-22 (est.); KES deal close Q4

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Q2 revenue $1.31B (+32%) at a 57% adjusted EBITDA margin. Tuesday's Summit keynote added Robinhood Agents (AI trading assistants on OpenAI and Anthropic models), US crypto perpetuals with up to 10x leverage in coming months, options trading 7:30am-4:15pm ET from October, weekend equities in early 2027 and earnings contracts with Cboe. Closed $116.22 before the keynote, -2.7% since Sep 28; BTIG lifted its target to $135 on strong September volumes.
risks: Perps and AI agents draw regulators; two engineers were charged Sep 15 with insider trading on crypto listings. Revenue swings with retail and crypto volumes at ~50x earnings, and 25% of volume is already off-hours.
catalyst: Wednesday's reaction to the Summit; Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-11-04 (est.)

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: LatAm's leading e-commerce and fintech platform; Q2 revenue $10.17B (+50%), the 30th straight quarter above 30%. Closed $1,724.90 Tuesday (+0.7%), down 1.6% since Sep 28 and 10% since Sep 14 on no company news; consensus target $2,272 (+32%).
risks: Operating margin is 6.7%, down from 12.2%, as it spends on shipping, credit and one-hour Sao Paulo delivery. Nu is competing hard in lending.

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Edge network that controls bot and AI-agent traffic; Q2 revenue $696M (+36%), 120% net retention. Closed $352.26 Tuesday (-0.5%, +0.9% since Sep 28), just under the Sep 22 record. Deutsche Telekom's T-Systems will now resell Cloudflare security across Europe with direct network interconnection, and Cloudflare is launching a public post-quantum certificate authority.
risks: Trades above the $337 consensus target at ~47x sales, so any growth miss will be punished. Gross margin fell 320bps to 73.1%.

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Q2 revenue $7.8B (+48%): Shopee GMV +28%, Monee loan book $11.1B at 1.0% NPLs. Closed $98.62 Tuesday (-0.3%), down 9% since Sep 14 on no company news. Consensus target $157 (+59%), still the widest gap on the list.
risks: Competition from TikTok Shop and Temu, and the Brazil push opens a second front against MELI. A Shopee executive's entity sold 60K shares Sep 21-22 under a 10b5-1 plan.

name: BYD
thesis: Exports drive growth: August overseas sales +134.5% YoY and European sales more than doubled, with local truck production in Europe planned. Fell 2.5% Tuesday to HK$75.75, -3% since Sep 28 and a fresh 52-week low, with no company news beyond the EGM; consensus HK$125.70 (+66%). Hong Kong -1.1% at 10:16 HKT vs 75.75 close, worse than the Hang Seng's -0.2%. September sales due Oct 1; Da Han sedan launches Oct 13 with a 1,008 km CLTC EV variant. USD at 7.8453 HKD (Yahoo, 30 Sep).
risks: August China sales -14.3% as Geely, Xpeng and Leapmotor take share; the price war squeezes margins and EU tariffs hang over exports. The tape is telling you nobody wants it ahead of the September number.

name: Keyence Corp
thesis: Machine vision and sensors for factory automation and robotics; fiscal Q1 sales +33%, net income +51%, operating margin above 50%. JPY 79,480 (+1.3% Tuesday, flat since Sep 28, +4% since Sep 15) at USD/JPY 157.4; Citi JPY 95,000, consensus JPY 97,867 (+23%). Tokyo +0.5% at 11:15 JST vs 79,480 close, in line with a 1.2% Nikkei rally. USD at 156.46 JPY (Yahoo, 30 Sep). No company news.
risks: The premium multiple assumes 30%+ growth. A stronger yen or slower China capex would hit both earnings and the multiple; Toyota's August numbers show Chinese and US auto demand softening.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: Sole EUV supplier; 2026 guide EUR 43-45B at 54-56% gross margin, 2027 EUV capacity essentially sold out. Rose 3.6% Tuesday to $1,834.39 (+5% since Sep 28, +17% since Sep 14) after JPMorgan said investors are rotating back into semis after the AI pullback. Consensus $2,116 (+15%).
risks: China export limits and proposed US chip tariffs. Sentiment-driven days cut both ways (-7.3% on Sep 14), and the Oct 14 bookings number has to back the rally.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Test equipment for AI and HBM chips (~70% of revenue) plus Universal Robots cobots; Q2 revenue $1.33B, more than double. Closed $403.02 Tuesday (+0.4%, +1.2% since Sep 28, +23% since Sep 14) and launched Magnum E2, a memory tester for LPDDR6, DDR6, GDDR7 and NAND with PAM3/PAM4 support, showing at SEMICON West Oct 13-15. Consensus $446 (+11%).
risks: The most volatile AI name on the list (-13.3% on Sep 14) at a premium multiple. Test orders are lumpy and come from a few customers.

name: Tesla
thesis: Car demand is falling while the valuation rests on robotaxi, storage and Optimus. The Roadster demo slipped again, from Oct 1 to Oct 15 at SpaceX's McGregor site, blamed on weather; Q3 deliveries still land Oct 2. Closed $352.84 Tuesday (-1.3%, -2.3% since Sep 28). Track it, don't chase it.
risks: JPMorgan cut its target to $415 and trimmed Q3 delivery estimates on Sep 28. The European Transport Safety Council urged EU states to reject FSD over its speed-offset feature the same day Croatia became the eighth country to approve it; the EU-wide vote is December at the earliest.
catalyst: Q3 deliveries 2026-10-02; Roadster demo 2026-10-15; Q3 earnings 2026-10-28
